title: Vintage Cousances Cast Iron Dutch Oven No. 24 – Rare – Made in France – Enameled Casserole
description:
Beautiful vintage Cousances enameled cast iron Dutch oven, size No. 24, made in France. Cousances was a historic French cookware manufacturer later acquired by Le Creuset, and their early cast iron pieces are well known for their excellent craftsmanship, durability, and classic French design.
This rare Cousances casserole features the traditional heavy enameled cast iron construction, providing outstanding heat retention and even heat distribution. Ideal for stews, soups, braising, roasting, and slow cooking.
Details:
• Brand: Cousances
• Type: Cast iron Dutch oven / casserole
• Size: No. 24
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Made in France
• Two side handles
• Matching lid included
• Rare vintage model
Condition:
Good vintage condition with normal signs of use consistent with age. The enamel interior remains clean and fully usable. Please review photos for full condition details.
A rare and collectible piece of classic French cookware, perfect for both everyday cooking and collectors of vintage Cousances / early Le Creuset era cast iron.
